title: Sage-A1.5: From Long-Horizon Execution to Scientific Exploration with Capability Composition
title_zh: Sage-A1.5：从长程执行到具备能力组合的科学探索

paragraphs.en: Sage-A1.5是35B混合专家智能体模型，通过能力组合实现长程任务执行与开放科学探索。 In this report, we introduce Sage-A1.5, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model that builds on A1 to advance long-horizon problem solving through adaptive capability composition. Compared with A1, Sage-A1.5 learns not only to solve individual tasks, but also to organize work and revise its approach during execution. Sage-A1.5 highlights three improvements: agentic orchestration, verification, and open scientific discovery. First, agentic orchestration extends single-agent execution through task delegation and parallel collaboration among subagents with isolated contexts, enabling complex tasks to be decomposed and addressed concurrently and supporting efficient execution while reducing interference across concurrent subagents. Second, agentic verification strengthens long-horizon reliability through progress checking, evidence validation, and reflective strategy revision, allowing the agent to recognize unproductive search paths and pursue alternative approaches. Third, open scientific discovery extends agentic capabilities beyond answering predefined questions to conducting exploratory research, connecting scientific inquiry with interactive analysis and inspectable research artifacts. We showcase these capabilities through complicated agentic tasks and multidisciplinary scientific applications. Besides, we hope Sage-A1.5 provides the community with an accessible foundation for open scientific discovery, offering a practical path from long-horizon task execution to collaborative, verifiable, and inspectable scientific exploration.
paragraphs.zh: Sage-A1.5是35B混合专家智能体模型，通过能力组合实现长程任务执行与开放科学探索。在本报告中，我们介绍Sage-A1.5，一个35B混合专家智能体模型，它在A1的基础上，通过自适应能力组合来推进长程问题求解。 与A1相比，Sage-A1.5不仅学会解决单个任务，还学会组织工作并在执行过程中调整自己的方法。 Sage-A1.5突出了三项改进：智能体编排、验证以及开放科学发现。 首先，智能体编排通过任务委派以及具有隔离上下文的子智能体之间的并行协作，扩展了单智能体执行，使复杂任务能够被分解并同时处理，在支持高效执行的同时减少了并发子智能体之间的相互干扰。 其次，智能体验证通过进度检查、证据核验和反思性策略修正来增强长程可靠性，使智能体能够识别无效的搜索路径并尝试其他方法。 第三，开放科学发现将智能体能力从回答预定义的问题扩展到开展探索性研究，将科学探究与交互式分析以及可审查的研究产物联系起来。 我们通过复杂的智能体任务和多学科科学应用来展示这些能力。 此外，我们希望Sage-A1.5能为社区提供一个易于使用的开放科学发现基础，提供一条从长程任务执行迈向协作式、可验证且可审查的科学探索的实用路径。
